effect.name: GM Fluid Refraction Field
effect.desc: Animated multi-octave liquid refraction with controllable glass dispersion and caustic highlights.
effect.shader: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}float n(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);return mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),mix(h(i+vec2(0,1)),h(i+1.0),f.x),f.y);}float f(vec2 p){float v=0.0,a=.5;for(int i=0;i<4;i++){v+=a*n(p);p=mat2(1.6,-1.2,1.2,1.6)*p;a*=.5;}return v;} void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));float t=acTime*(0.08+0.22*(1.0-viscosity))+evolution;vec2 p=uv*scale+vec2(t,-t*.73);float e=.02;float c=f(p),dx=f(p+vec2(e,0))-f(p-vec2(e,0)),dy=f(p+vec2(0,e))-f(p-vec2(0,e));vec2 normal=vec2(dx,dy)/e;vec2 off=normal*refractionPx/sz;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec2 duv=clamp(uv+off,0.0,1.0);vec2 d=normalize(normal+vec2(.0001))*dispersionPx/sz;vec4 base=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,duv);vec3 rgb=vec3(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(duv+d,0.0,1.0)).r,base.g,texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(duv-d,0.0,1.0)).b);rgb+=pow(clamp(abs(dx+dy)*2.5,0.0,1.0),3.0)*caustics;gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,rgb,mixAmount),mix(src.a,base.a,mixAmount));}
